blocks.heading: Averages and deviation
lines: Average = total ÷ number, so total = average × number.
Deviation method: pick a guess, add the gaps, divide.
68, 72, 75, 70, 65 with guess 70: gaps -2, +2, +5, 0, -5 add to 0, so average 70.

blocks.heading: Adding or removing members
lines: Change in total = change in average × number of members.
8 persons, average up 2.5 when 65 kg is replaced: new person = 65 + 8 × 2.5 = 85.
Remove one: 6 numbers average 15, other 5 average 14, removed = 90 - 70 = 20.

blocks.heading: Weighted average
lines: 30 students at 40 and 20 at 55: weights 3 : 2, so 40 + 2/5 × 15 = 46.
The overall average sits closer to the group with more members.

blocks.heading: Alligation
lines: The mixture needs more of the item the mean is closer to.

blocks.heading: Repeated replacement
lines: Left after n steps = original × (1 - removed ÷ total)^n.
40 L, take out 8 and refill with water, twice: 40 × 0.8 × 0.8 = 25.6 L of milk.
